<thought>To determine the number of methyl groups, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample (the molecule in question) using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Methyl carbons typically appear in the upfield region (~10‑30 ppm). By counting the distinct carbon signals in that region, I can infer the number of methyl groups.</thought>
